scope: Offline paired replay of the same retained Spell-50 decisions. This measures controller sensitivity to the removed non-native uncertainty growth; it is not physical survival evidence.
sample_method: 100 evenly spaced eligible decisions using floor(index * eligible_count / 100)
interpretation: The removed growth materially changed policy semantics without a meaningful timing benefit. Synthetic CE-0078 regression coverage remains executable after the raw trace is deleted.
